Own this pipeline stage end-to-end this week (schema/contract, service or agent, prompts where relevant, and tests) - a full vertical slice of the pipeline, not a single horizontal layer.
Follow the team Git workflow: branch from main, commit incrementally with clear messages, keep prompts/code modular, and open a Pull Request when the task is complete.

Integrate only through the structured JSON each stage exchanges (consume the previous stage's output, emit the next stage's input) so the slice has no external blockers and merges conflict-free; keep prompts/interfaces modular and versioned.
